item.title: President Trump to address the nation in State of the Union Address
item.description: President Donald Trump is set to address the nation Thursday night for his first State of the Union Address in his second term, with many curious to see how he will address the US Supreme Court ruling on tariffs and what his plans are for the future.

item.title: Waymo vehicles could soon be coming to Charlotte
item.description: Waymo vehicles have been seen parked in a lot near Uptown, and Waymo executives expect to share more information on Wednesday, Feb. 25.

item.title: 16-year-old suspect charged in Rock Hill robbery death denied release
item.description: Three teens were involved in an altercation at a Rock Hill parking deck that resulted in the death of 15-year-old Za'veon Heath, who was shot multiple times, and the 16-year-old girl who left the scene was later taken into custody.

item.title: Kings Mountain leaders pause potential data center projects amid community concerns
item.description: Kings Mountain City Council voted to approve a six-month moratorium on new data centers in their community to further investigate the potential impacts on water resources, noise, and power bills.

item.title: Four taken into ICE custody at Mecklenburg County Courthouse
item.description: Four people were taken into ICE custody at the Mecklenburg County Courthouse, and ICE agents threatened to arrest three attorneys for attempting to interfere with the arrests.
